description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the Slap Service Component Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) system. It includes functions related to object naming, object type retrieval, engagement, cancellation, matching, invocation dispatch, and parameter conversion.

methods.name: SlapScoGetObjName2
methods.description: Retrieves the object name as a string.

methods.name: SlapScoSetObjName
methods.description: Sets the object's name with the provided string.

methods.name: SlapScoGetObjType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier of the object.

methods.name: SlapScoEngage
methods.description: Engages the service component, likely initializing or starting it.

methods.name: SlapScoCancel
methods.description: Cancels or stops the service component.

methods.name: SlapScoMatch1
methods.description: Checks if the object matches given name and instance id.

methods.name: SlapScoInvokeDispatch
methods.description: Invokes a method by name with input parameters, providing output parameters and a return variable.

methods.name: SlapScoConvertParams
methods.description: Converts parameter lists between different formats or representations.
